gate_principles.task_owned_process_provenance_required: Runtime evidence needs a PID and ownership chain.
gate_principles.bounded_wait_required: A caller hang is not a valid measurement.
gate_principles.owned_child_recovery_only: Recovery may not disturb unrelated local work.

gate_principles.solve_provenance_required: ARC credit must come from the live process on unseen games.
gate_principles.arc_registry_hash_required: Registry nonmutation prevents post-hoc credit drift.

gate_principles.parse_content_separated: Format recovery can mimic self-correction without semantic gain.
gate_principles.hidden_test_content_margin_required: Content claims require already-parseable hidden-test movement.

gate_principles.post_outcome_commit_only: Decision-time writes can leak labels into the current prediction.
gate_principles.model_weight_mutation_allowed: This milestone tests system memory, not parameter updates.
gate_principles.rollback_required: Unsafe memory must be exactly reversible.

gate_principles.treatment_activation_required: A null with no treatment fire is an instrument failure.
gate_principles.positive_control_required: A sampler A/B needs proof that the harness can detect movement.

gate_principles.hardware_claim_allowed_without_receipt: Product-roadmap text is not execution evidence.
gate_principles.authenticated_route_required: Hardware claims need a local or authenticated route.

preconditions_checked.principle: Hashing inputs before search prevents hidden context or roadmap drift.

status.principle: The terminal state follows source novelty, roadmap, command, and freeze-contract checks.

planner_marker_and_hash.principle: The exact V539 marker defines the runtime novelty boundary.

bootstrap_artifact_write_receipt.principle: The minimal atomic write proves the task preserved preconditions before optional network work.

query_window.principle: Only evidence strictly after the marker can be a runtime delta.

source_channel_receipts.principle: Every required source channel records success, null, duplicate, or failure.

discovered_candidates.principle: All found rows stay visible before classification.

accepted_findings.principle: Only strict post-marker primary or first-party V539 deltas are accepted.

rejected_or_duplicate_findings.principle: Rejected rows explain why references stayed unchanged.

accepted_count.principle: Null or zero records a null search without blocking later freeze-dependent tasks.

references_append_receipt.principle: References stay byte-identical on a null and append-only on a delta.

frozen_runtime_contract.principle: Runtime ownership must be explicit before long local model jobs run.

frozen_arc_provenance_contract.principle: ARC solve credit requires live-agent self-discovery and no hidden source access.

frozen_code_content_margin_contract.principle: Parse repair and semantic hidden-test content gains must stay separated.

frozen_csl_contract.principle: Fresh self-learning may write memory only after verified outcomes.

frozen_sampler_activation_contract.principle: Sampler comparisons are invalid when the treatment never fires.

frozen_hardware_boundary.principle: Hardware claims need a new authenticated route or physical-state receipt.

roadmap_path_and_hash.principle: The audited active and staged roadmap identities are content-addressed.

roadmap_schema_result.principle: Roadmap, gate, model, retired-dependency, and prompt checks must pass mechanically.

exclusion_manifest_lint_result.principle: Retired scopes stay closed unless the manifest allows them.

prior_failure_contract_result.principle: Reruns must explain how they differ from prior failures.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: The task must not rewrite conductor, roadmap, ops ledgers, or registry state.

preconditions_checked.principle: Marker, staged roadmap, protected files, and source inputs are hashed before final work.

inference_substrate.principle: Declares deterministic source and roadmap audit rather than live LLM inference.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: False because this audit validates metadata, not benchmark answers.

field_provenance.principle: Each required field traces to marker, receipts, roadmap checks, contracts, or commands.

field_principles.principle: Every required field carries the reason it exists.

test_commands.principle: Records focused, coverage, roadmap, exclusion, retired-dependency, prompt, full-suite, and adversarial checks.

test_exit_codes.principle: Focused gate failures block; the broad suite is recorded and nonblocking only for unrelated existing failures.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: Detects later drift in the artifact payload.

honest_verdict.principle: The verdict preserves null, delta, or blocked state without overclaiming.
